caption: Temple of Poseidon, Sounion
composition: Partial Doric colonnade on the Sounion cliff, lit until sunrise · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the cliff at Cape Sounion, a roofless partial Doric colonnade of the Temple of Poseidon stands above the Aegean, with gaps where columns are missing. The sky is clear, about 15.2°C, with a light wind near 8 km/h. The published lighting control runs from sunset to sunrise, and sunrise is about 07:14, so the columns are lit. Published counts of standing columns differ, so the frame does not claim an exact number.
